title: ECS Task Metadata V4 coverage
intro: The four ECS Task Metadata V4 routes the emulator advertises. Each is an HTTP GET
keyed by a per-container token that a real task receives in
when the container starts, and a test process is never inside that container. The
suite therefore registers the token through the emulator's own `register_container`
with the same payloads and then asks over HTTP, and it skips on a lab where the
token belongs to the emulator's process.
